args.title: Fix password reset emails linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links like /reports and /reports/${report.id}) sent in emails. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, users receive emails pointing at localhost, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production deployment configuration, and/or make the code fail fast (throw or log an error at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, rather than silently defaulting to localhost. This prevents a misconfiguration from silently leaking a dev-only URL into user-facing emails like password resets.
